attempts.summary: Set up a 5-minute cron job on node2 that pulls /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1 (source of truth) via rsync-over-SSH using the cluster keypair, only overwriting the local file when content differs. Verified the sync works automatically (well under the 15-minute SLA), then performed the mandatory single-node-at-a-time restart protocol on both node1 and node2, confirming boot identity changes and full recovery of services, cron persistence, and continued file synchronization afterward.
